result.response:
The behavioral regression was in [`api/errors.go`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-2042644242/acap-bench-184762783/api/errors.go#L18-L25): [`CodeConflict`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-2042644242/acap-bench-184762783/api/errors.go#L11) was incorrectly mapped in [`statusByCode`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-2042644242/acap-bench-184762783/api/errors.go#L18) to `http.StatusBadRequest` (400) instead of `http.StatusConflict` (409), causing `POST /items` with duplicate SKUs to respond with 400 instead of 409.

### Changes Made
- Updated [`statusByCode`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-2042644242/acap-bench-184762783/api/errors.go#L18-L25) in [`api/errors.go`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-2042644242/acap-bench-184762783/api/errors.go) to map `CodeConflict` to `http.StatusConflict`.
- Verified that all unit tests pass across the entire repository (`go test -v ./...`).
- Preserved refactor structures ([`statusByCode`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-2042644242/acap-bench-184762783/api/errors.go#L18) and [`respondError`](file:///tmp/agentcap-agent-trial-2042644242/acap-bench-184762783/api/handlers.go#L30)), leaving changes uncommitted and test files untouched.
